name: cli-translator
description: Translate ARM template or REST API to CLI scripts

subcommands.name: arm
subcommands.description: Translate ARM template to CLI scripts(Currently only support Compute, Network and Storage)

subcommands.name: translate
subcommands.description: Translate ARM template to CLI scripts(Currently only support Compute, Network and Storage)

options.name: --parameters
options.description: The local path or url of parameters.json file

name: --resource-group
-g
options.description: Name of resource group. You can configure the default group using az configure --defaults group=<name>

options.name: --template
options.description: The local path or url of template.json file

options.name: --target-subscription
options.description: The target subscription id. If omit, the current subscription id will be used
